name: What's Up
overview:
What's up is a Croatian documentary television series written and hosted by Goran Milić, which has been airing since January 18, 2021 on Croatian Radio and Television (HRT).[1][2]

In each season of the series, Milić explores the political, social, and cultural peculiarities of different countries and cities through a travelogue format, talking to local residents, intellectuals, artists, and politicians.
